target_options_help.approved_crop: Use root-relative approved reference path/hash, full-reference crop_xywh and feature_bbox_xywh, and the exact identity/style/feature authority.
target_options_help.orientation_diagram: Use mode, authority, and directions with head/torso/feet each viewer-left, viewer-right, front or back; optional chair with the same values; gaze_target explains recipient. This governs orientation only.
target_options_help.local_diagram: Use mode, root-relative locally authored PNG path/hash, crop_xywh, feature_bbox_xywh, authority and creation_method=local_programmatic_diagram. Never use an AI-generated replacement or invent an identity master.
